title: BMW iX4 Electric SUV Design Patented In India: What To Expect?
summary: BMW seems to be planning to introduce a new coupe-style electric SUV in India. Although BMW has not officially confirmed the BMW iX4 India launch, the design patent raises the possibility of the German marque aiming to expand its electrified range here. 2027 BMW iX4 Rear (Representative Image) From the inside, the BMW iX4 looks similar to the iX3 SUV, with features such as Panoramic Vision display and a 17.9-inch touchscreen and Panoramic Vision display.
